title: Why the Cloud‑9 Galaxy Disappeared Overnight

scenes.text: The mysterious Cloud‑9 galaxy vanished without a single star
It contains virtually no stars, making it the first confirmed ‘failed’ galaxy
scenes.label: STARLESS GALAXY

scenes.text: Scientists think it formed in a low‑density region where dark matter couldn’t pull gas together
scenes.label: DARK MATTER SCARCITY

scenes.text: Its discovery was confirmed using the Hubble Space Telescope’s deep‑field imaging in 2023
scenes.label: HUBBLE CONFIRMATION

scenes.text: Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: A rare look at the only galaxy discovered without stars, shedding light on how dark matter shapes the cosmos. Follow for daily science!
